title: Performy
description: Fast, lightweight optimization modpack packed with the most performance by far.
body:
[![Published by Panda Studios by MinePandas](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd8860ebbb37eb5296df0400f5e3a8910f75caee.png)](https://modrinth.com/organization/panda)

**Performy** is a **lightweight**, **balanced** and **fast** modpack that is by far faster then 99% of other optimization modpacks **without compromising on any features**!

## Comparisons
| Feature        | Performy      | Preformium      | Fabulously Optimized      |
|----------------|---------------|-----------------|---------------------------|
| FPS    | 463 FPS       | 301 FPS         | 111 FPS                   |
| Versions       | 26.1          | 1.20.4-26.1     | 1.16.5-26.1.2             |
| Open Source        | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes |
| Borderless fullscreen | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes | ❌ No |
| Zoomify        | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes |
| In Game Texture Pack download        | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes | ❌ No |
| Bloatware        | ✅ None | ⚠️ Minimal | ❌ A lot |
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
![Comparison](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16927d3ad19dfc9c689d7805d7a90557c56f9cd4_0.webp)
_All of the images are taken in the same server, under the same circumstances, with the same settings!_
